Nepalese mountaineer Nirmal Purja dies in avalanche on Broad Peak

Veteran Nepalese mountaineer Nirmal Purja died in an avalanche on Broad Peak in Pakistan's PoK region, days after the mountain experienced a major avalanche. The incident occurred on February 11, 2023. Nirmal Purja was 45 years old. He had set multiple records for climbing the world's highest peaks. The bodies of nine other climbers were recovered from the site. The cause of the avalanche is under investigation.
